title: gladiolus suaveolens
intro: Gladiolus suaveolens, commonly known as Sweet Gladiolus, is a flowering plant species in the family Iridaceae. The plant is rich in antioxidants, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Gladiolus suaveolens has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its therapeutic actions, such as treating digestive issues, fever reduction, and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its benefits and potential applications.
